From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bench interviewer activation and load-leveling for SRE candidate wave

Team —

We have an influx of SRE on-site slots next week (5 strong candidates, staggered panels). Our usual interviewers are at capacity Friday + Monday. Can we activate the interviewer bench and do some load-leveling so we don't push offers/feedback windows beyond the 72-hour SLA?

I attached a quick availability grid (bench_availability_grid.xlsx) and a blank debrief template. Proposed approach:
- Pull two bench interviewers for the technical deep-dives (system design + debugging)
- One bench for behavioral/culture so hiring manager doesn't get overloaded
- Rotate the bench so no one takes more than 2 panels in a day

Please reply with: (1) names you can pull, (2) any hard blackout windows, and (3) whether you want to run these as shortened 40-miners to save interviewer cycles.

Candidate contact is below (Elena Park, coordinated by Ellen at TopTech Recruiters). Ellen thinks Elena can do morning slots PST next Tue/Wed.

Thanks — short timeline on this.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Hiring Manager, Core Infra
Redwood Inference
